This supplemental information contains the R code for all data processing reported in the manuscript (data are publicly available at https://osf.io/9b4y7/).



```{r, echo=FALSE, message = FALSE}
# Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)

options(scipen=999)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache=TRUE)

```

## Custom Functions
```{r}

# calculate standard errors
se <- function(x, na.rm = FALSE) {
  if (na.rm) {
    the.SE <- sqrt(var(x,na.rm=TRUE)/length(na.omit(x)))
  } else {
    the.SE <- sqrt(var(x,na.rm=FALSE)/length(x))
  }
  
  return(the.SE)
}

# count unique users and sessions in a data frame
user.sessions <- function(data) {
  us <- data %>%
    #group_by(block, face_sex) %>%
    group_by() %>% 
    summarise(
      subjects = n_distinct(oc_id),
      sessions = n_distinct(paste0(oc_id,date))
      #nonusers = round(mean(block_pill==0)*100, 1),
      #pillusers = round(mean(block_pill==1)*100, 1)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  kable(us)
}

```


# Load data 

Data entered from all white, heterosexual women not using non-pill HCs (only pill or no HC). An additional 25 women were recruited for the study. These 25 women's data are not included here because they reported using forms of oral contraceptive (e.g., progesterone-only pill) other than the combined oral contraceptive pill. 

Each row is a single face rating.

* "oc_id"          = ID of the subject       
* "block"          = testing block (1, 2 or 3)
* "age"            = age (in years) of subject on day of testing    
* "ethnicity"      = ethnic group of subject (all white)
* "sexpref"        = sexual preference of subject (all heterosexual)
* "date"           = date of testing session
* "pill"           = is subject currently using OCP (0 = no hormonal contraception, 1 = using OCP)
* "pill_break"     = is subject taking active or inactive pills (0 = inactive, 1 = active)
* "pill_break_day" = if on the pill break, which day (1-7)
* "partner"        = does subject currently have a romantic partner? (0 = no partner, 1 = yes partner)
* "block_pill"       = all unique pill column values in the block (0 if never used OCP, 1 if always used OCP, otherwised mixed: e.g., 1,0)
* "block_partner"  = all unique partner column values in the block (0 if never had partner, 1 if always had partner, otherwised mixed: e.g., 1,0)
* "face_sex"       = sex of the stimulus face
* "context"        = type of relationship for which facial attractiveness was judged (ST = short term, LT = long term, NA = no context specificed (female faces only))
* "progesterone"   = salivary progesterone for that session
* "estradiol"      = salivary estradiol for that session
* "testosterone"   = salivary testosterone for that session
* "cortisol"       = salivary cortisol for that session
* "manip"          = face manipulation (sexdim, health, avg or sym)      
* "face_id"        = ID of the stimulus face
* "rating"         = face preference score (7 = strongest possible preference for increased sexdim, health, avg or sym, 0 = strongest possible preference for decreased sexdim, health, avg or sym)

Male facial masculinity preferences are trials where face_sex == "male" and manip == "sexdim". Higher scores indicate stronger masculinity preferences. 

```{r}

data_all <- read.csv("OCMATE_facepref_anon.csv", stringsAsFactors = F)

user.sessions(data_all)

```

## Re-code variables

Group by oc_id/date/context/manip/face_sex

* context.e = context (ST = +0.5, LT = -0.5, NA = NA) 
* partner.e = partnership status (no = -0.5, partner = +0.5, mixed = NA)
* pill.e    = pill use (no pill= -0.5, pill = +0.5)
* rating.c  = calculate mean rating and centre on 3.5
* session_n = testing session number starting at 0 (to control for testing order)

```{r}

sub_both_consistent <- data_all %>%
  # exclude subject-blocks with inconsistently reported pill use
  filter(block_pill == "0" | block_pill =="1") %>%
  mutate(block_pill = as.integer(block_pill)) %>%
  group_by(
    context, manip, face_sex,
    oc_id, date, 
    # variables consistent by oc_id/date
    age, pill, pill_break, pill_break_day, 
    block, block_pill, block_partner,
    progesterone, estradiol, testosterone, cortisol
  ) %>%
  summarise(rating.c = mean(rating) - 3.5) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    "prog" = progesterone,
    "estr" = estradiol,
    "test" = testosterone,
    "cort" = cortisol
  ) %>%
  mutate( 
    context.e = ifelse(context == "ST", 0.5, ifelse(context == 'LT', -0.5, NA)),
    partner.e = ifelse(block_partner==0, -0.5, ifelse(block_partner==1, 0.5, NA)),
    pill.e  = ifelse(block_pill==1,0.5,-0.5)
  ) %>%
  # add session n
  arrange(oc_id, date) %>% 
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  mutate(session_n = dense_rank(as.character(date)) - 1) %>% 
  ungroup()

user.sessions(sub_both_consistent)

```


## Overall subject descriptive statistics

### mean age at start of testing

```{r}

sub_both_consistent %>% 
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  summarise(
    min_age = min(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(min_age = ifelse(is.infinite(min_age), NA, min_age)) %>% # fixes 100% NA ages returning min(age) = Inf
  group_by() %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_age = mean(min_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(min_age, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% t()

```

### Number of subjects per block combination 

(after excluding blocks with inconsistent pill use reported)

```{r}

sub_both_consistent %>%
  select(oc_id, block) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(block = paste0("block", block)) %>%
  spread(block, block) %>%
  mutate(block_list = paste(block1, block2, block3)) %>%
  group_by(block_list) %>%
  summarise(n = n())
```

### Intervals between end of a block and start of next block

```{r}

# 187 women did both 1 and 2; 17 women did both 2 and 3
sub_both_consistent %>%
  group_by(oc_id, block) %>%
  summarise(
    min_date = min(date),
    max_date = max(date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gather(key, value, c(min_date, max_date)) %>%
  mutate( key = paste0(key, block)) %>%
  select(-block) %>%
  spread(key, value) %>%
  mutate(
    int1to2 = interval( ymd(max_date1), ymd(min_date2)) / ddays(1),
    int2to3 = interval( ymd(max_date2), ymd(min_date3)) / ddays(1)
  ) %>%
  group_by() %>%
  summarise(
    int1to2_mean = mean(int1to2, na.rm = TRUE),
    int1to2_sd = sd(int1to2, na.rm = TRUE),
    int1to2_se = se(int1to2, na.rm = TRUE),
    int2to3_mean = mean(int2to3, na.rm = TRUE),
    int2to3_sd = sd(int2to3, na.rm = TRUE),
    int2to3_se = se(int2to3, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>% gather("stat", "value", 1:length(.)) %>%
  separate(stat, into=c("interval", "stat")) %>%
  spread(stat, value)

```


### The number of women who completed one, two, three, four, or five weekly test sessions by block

```{r}

sub_both_consistent %>%
  group_by(oc_id, block) %>%
  summarise(
    sessions = n_distinct(date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(block, sessions) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  spread(sessions, n)

```


### The number of sessions completed per woman

```{r}

sub_both_consistent %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  summarise(
    sessions = n_distinct(date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(sessions) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  spread(sessions, n) %>% t()

```

# Data subsets

## data_hormones (H1)

### Exclude women on the pill

```{r}

sub_nonpill <- sub_both_consistent %>%
  filter(block_pill=="0")

user.sessions(sub_nonpill)

```


### Exclude observations with missing estradiol, progesterone or testosterone

```{r}

## Exclude observations with EPT missing hormone values 
sub_nonpill_hormones <- sub_nonpill %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(prog) | 
    !is.na(estr) | 
    !is.na(test)
  )

user.sessions(sub_nonpill_hormones)

```


### Exclude subjects with only a single session in a block 

This is necessary because you can't calculate subject-centered means with only one data point.

```{r}
## separately by face_sex
sub_hormones_full <- sub_nonpill_hormones %>%
  group_by(oc_id, block, face_sex) %>%
  mutate(sessions = n_distinct(date)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(sessions > 1)

user.sessions(sub_hormones_full)

```

### Remove outlier hormone values 

Remove below bottom sensitivity thresholds for assays (prog < 5, estr < 0.1) and remove outlier values (+/- 3SD from the mean).

```{r}

sub_hormones_avg_no_outliers <- sub_hormones_full %>%
  mutate(
    prog = ifelse(prog >= 5, prog, NA),
    estr = ifelse(estr >= 0.1, estr, NA),
    prog = ifelse(prog>mean(prog, na.rm=TRUE)+3*sd(prog, na.rm=TRUE) | 
                  prog<mean(prog, na.rm=TRUE)-3*sd(prog, na.rm=TRUE), NA, prog),
    estr = ifelse(estr>mean(estr, na.rm=TRUE)+3*sd(estr, na.rm=TRUE) | 
                  estr<mean(estr, na.rm=TRUE)-3*sd(estr, na.rm=TRUE), NA, estr),
    test = ifelse(test>mean(test, na.rm=TRUE)+3*sd(test, na.rm=TRUE) | 
                  test<mean(test, na.rm=TRUE)-3*sd(test, na.rm=TRUE), NA, test),
    cort = ifelse(cort>mean(cort, na.rm=TRUE)+3*sd(cort, na.rm=TRUE) | 
                  cort<mean(cort, na.rm=TRUE)-3*sd(cort, na.rm=TRUE), NA, cort)
  )

# how many included?
sub_hormones_avg_no_outliers %>%
  group_by(oc_id, date, block) %>%
  summarise(
    e = is.na(mean(estr)),
    p = is.na(mean(prog)),
    t = is.na(mean(test)),
    c = is.na(mean(cort))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(block, e:c) %>%
  gather('hormone','na', e:c) %>%
  group_by(hormone, block) %>%
  summarise(
    'valid' = n() - sum(na),
    'excluded' = sum(na)
  ) %>%
  arrange(block, hormone) %>%
  group_by() %>%
  summarise(
    total_hormone_samples_valid = sum(valid),
    total_hormone_samples_excluded = sum(excluded)
  ) %>% gather("stat", "value", 1:length(.))

```

### Subject-mean-centre hormones

Divide results by a constant to put all hormones on ~ -0.5 to +0.5 scale

```{r}

data_hormones <- sub_hormones_avg_no_outliers %>%
group_by(oc_id, face_sex) %>%
  mutate(
    prog.s = (prog-mean(prog, na.rm=TRUE))/400,
    estr.s = (estr-mean(estr, na.rm=TRUE))/5,
    test.s = (test-mean(test, na.rm=TRUE))/100,
    cort.s = (cort-mean(cort, na.rm=TRUE))/0.5,
    ep_ratio.s = ((estr/prog)-mean(estr/prog, na.rm=TRUE))/0.075
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

saveRDS(data_hormones, file="data_hormones.Rda")

# graph to confirm hormones are scaled approximately the same

data_hormones %>%
  group_by(oc_id, date, prog.s, estr.s, test.s, cort.s,ep_ratio.s) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  gather("hormone", "value", prog.s:ep_ratio.s) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, colour=hormone)) + 
  geom_density(alpha=.5) + 
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-1,1))
  
```

## data_hormones_partner (H1)

Only women with consistently reported partnership status for tests of effects of endogenous hormones (no OCP users) considering effects of partnership status. Because women who reported their partnership status inconsistently are not included in partnership analyses, Ns for all partnership analyses will be slightly smaller.

```{r}

data_hormones_partner <- data_hormones %>%
  filter(block_partner == "0" | block_partner =="1") %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  mutate(pchange = mean(partner.e)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(pchange %in% c(-.5, .5)) %>%
  select(-pchange)

saveRDS(data_hormones_partner, file="data_hormones_partner.Rda")

user.sessions(data_hormones_partner)

```


## data_between (H2)

Pill as a between-participant variable (excluding switchers) for tests for between-group differences. Women reporting use of the combined oral contraceptive pill or no use of hormonal contraceptives across all test sessions.

```{r}

data_between <- sub_both_consistent %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  mutate(switch = !(mean(block_pill) %in% c(0,1)) ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(switch == 0) %>%
  select(-switch)

saveRDS(data_between, file="data_between.Rda")

user.sessions(data_between)

```

## data_between_partner (H2)

Exclude women who inconsistently reported partnership within blocks & between blocks

```{r}

data_between_partner <- data_between %>%
  filter(!is.na(partner.e)) %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  mutate(pchange = mean(partner.e)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(pchange %in% c(-.5, .5)) %>%
  select(-pchange)

saveRDS(data_between_partner, file="data_between_partner.Rda")

user.sessions(data_between_partner)

```


## data_pillbreak (H3)

Women who were tested at least once during a scheduled break from use of the combined oral contraceptive pill to test for a within-subject effect of pill break.

coding: using active pill= 0.5, using inactive pill/being on on a pill break = -0.5

```{r}

data_pillbreak <- sub_both_consistent %>%
  filter(block_pill == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    # reassign the pill_break according to the pill_break_day
    # for women who did not report pill_break_day, check their pill_break==0 (on break)
    on_break = ifelse(is.na(pill_break_day), pill_break==0, TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(oc_id, block) %>%
  mutate(prop.break = mean(on_break)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # exclude participants who did not change the pattern within block
  filter(prop.break != 0 & prop.break != 1) %>%
  select(-pill_break, -pill_break_day) %>%
  mutate(pill_break.e = ifelse(on_break==0,.5, -.5))

saveRDS(data_pillbreak, file="data_pillbreak.Rda")

user.sessions(data_pillbreak)
  
```

## data_pillbreak_partner (H3)

Exclude women with inconsistent partnership within any blocks

```{r}

data_pillbreak_partner <- data_pillbreak %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  mutate(inconsistent = mean(partner.e)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(inconsistent)) %>%
  select(-inconsistent)

saveRDS(data_pillbreak_partner, file="data_pillbreak_partner.Rda")
    
user.sessions(data_pillbreak_partner)

```


## data_pill_switchers (H4)

Women who switched from using no hormonal contraceptive to using the combined oral contraceptive pill (or vice versa) between blocks of test sessions.

```{r}

sub_pill_switchers <- sub_both_consistent %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  mutate(switch = !(mean(block_pill) %in% c(0,1)) ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(switch == 1) %>%
  select(-switch)

# effect code order (if block1 no pill = -0.5, if block 1 pill = +0.5)
direction_calc <- sub_pill_switchers %>%
  filter(block==1) %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  summarise(direction.e = mean(pill.e)) %>%
  ungroup() 

data_pill_switchers <- sub_pill_switchers %>%
  left_join(direction_calc, by=c('oc_id'))

saveRDS(data_pill_switchers, file="data_pill_switchers.Rda")

user.sessions(data_pill_switchers)

```


## data_pill_switchers_partner (H4)

Exclude women from data_pill_switchers with inconsistent partnership within any blocks

```{r}

data_pill_switchers_partner <- data_pill_switchers %>%
  group_by(oc_id) %>%
  # mean partner.e will be NA if partner.e is ever NA
  mutate(inconsistent = mean(partner.e)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(inconsistent)) %>%
  select(-inconsistent)

saveRDS(data_pill_switchers_partner, file="data_pill_switchers_partner.Rda")

user.sessions(data_pill_switchers_partner)

```
